purpose: Xbox home streaming (unofficial). Protocol ported from Greenlight; WebRTC through libdatachannel built by vcpkg.

greenlight.use: protocol reference (packages/player, packages/desktop/main/helpers); no code linked

xal-node.use: MSAL device-code sign-in sequence (src/msal.ts); ported, not linked

vcpkg.install_root: C:/veyra-deps/xbox-installed (a copy of remoteplay-installed plus the packages below; same OpenSSL 3.6.4)

patches.libjuice/ipv4-interrupt.diff: The poll thread's wake-up socket binds 127.0.0.1 instead of "localhost". Where IPv6 loopback drops UDP (seen on the development machine with a VPN/TUN adapter) the wake-up packet to ::1 is lost without an error, and ICE checks wait for the 60 s poll timeout.
